selection.rule: first chronological price-audit cuts with research_history_weight >= minimum_weight, before inspecting engine forecasts or outcomes

financials: Reconstruct strictly prior-day filed positive TTM using archived companyfacts EPS versions; retain reported origin-share EPS, omit unavailable quality fields and allow production reliability penalties
catalogue: Frozen current sector and growth/multiple assumptions; explicitly retrospective fixed policy, not historically calibrated parameters
holdings_clock: Engine observed_at is an explicitly labelled virtual public-availability clock, one day after the conservative filing threshold; actual retrieval is preserved separately. Never a historical capture claim
dividends: Trailing provider ex-date amounts only, rebased to origin-share units under the declared provider-basis hypothesis; no future events or payment-calendar inputs
risk_scope: Production dynamic EWMA factor/residual path, not historical GJR reestimation; never reuse the current volatility file
entrypoint: referenceRequest -> prepareComposition -> composeMultiStart, using unchanged production modules
account_policy: Independent reference account at every selected cut; not a continuous backtested account. Preserve reference mandate, cash-dividend policy, costs, risk constraints and trade gates
limitations: Current surviving catalogue and ex-post event exclusions
Only the covered stock subset plus historical SPY benchmark and cash; historical bond and other ETF profiles absent
EPS versions reconstructed from later companyfacts extraction; original full financial quality and submission coverage absent
Provider price and dividend bases reconstructed ex post, not original historical vendor captures or certified execution cashflows
Current fixed policy parameters and explicit EWMA risk variant
Selected noncontiguous origins cannot establish complete-period strategy performance
No fresh holdout, no realized-return scoring and no predictive or economic validation
